Regions / AI Literacy

AI Literacy

Coming soon

Students learn how AI systems learn from examples, where they succeed and fail, and how to evaluate what they produce.

Topics

  • How machine learning works
  • Training data
  • Generative AI
  • Evaluating AI output
  • Bias in AI systems
Find it on the map

Activity ideas

Unplugged ideas for each topic, to be written up as full activities.

  • Paper Classifier · How machine learning works

    Groups sort picture cards into two groups, write rules that explain the sort, then test their rules on new cards.

  • Different Decks · Training data

    Each group trains its paper classifier on a different card deck, and the class compares how the classifiers disagree on the same new cards.

  • Next-Word Dice · Generative AI

    Students tally which word follows which in a short text, then generate new sentences by rolling dice against their tally table, like a tiny language model.

  • Fact Check · Evaluating AI output

    Students check printed, AI-style answers against source cards and find the confident mistakes.

  • Who Gets Missed? · Bias in AI systems

    Students look for whose faces, voices, or names are missing from a training deck, then predict who the classifier will get wrong.

Activities

Full activities for this region are being written. Each will be unplugged, with a teacher guide and print-ready handouts, and students will need no technology.
